title: Why Regenerative Organic? | Part 3: What We’re Doing (and Why)
summary: Apparel brand's promo for regenerative organic agriculture as organic plus soil, animal welfare and labour standards, claiming small regenerative organic farms out-yield industrial agriculture and resist drought.

assertions.quote: regenerative organic agriculture takes the best parts of organic agriculture and it builds on it
the yield can be six to eight times more than industrial agriculture

verdicts.note: Comparative studies find organic and regenerative systems usually yield less or about the same per acre as conventional, not several times more.

Even with diversification practices (organic polycultures or more rotations) the organic yield gap shrank to 9% and 8% but did not reverse; no setting showed organic yielding far more than conventional.

assertions.quote: every time it rains water doesn't run off drought resistant
